0.text: My son came back from camp full of enthusiasm! His technical progress is incredible, and he made new friends too.

1.text: Professional approach, excellent organization. The kids are constantly active and learn through play. I recommend it to everyone!

2.text: This is the third year in a row we're sending our son to a Coerver camp. Every year he comes back with new skills and an even greater love for football.

0.question: What should a child bring to camp?
0.answer: Football boots or trainers, shin guards, a water bottle, personal hygiene items and a good attitude! You receive Coerver equipment at the camp.

1.question: Is lunch included?
1.answer: Depending on the duration of the camp, players have a meal included, i.e. lunch and/or a snack.

2.question: What if a child has no previous experience?
2.answer: Our camps are adapted to all levels - from complete beginners to advanced players. Groups are formed by age and ability.

3.question: How can I cancel my registration?
3.answer: Free cancellation up to 14 days before the start of the camp. After that, we retain 50% of the amount paid.

whatIsCoerver.title: What is Coerver<r>®</r> Coaching?
whatIsCoerver.subtitle: A global football education company that developed the world's number 1 method for teaching football skills.
whatIsCoerver.description: <green>Coerver® Coaching</green> is today present in over <bold>60 countries</bold> across every continent, and is used by some of the world's best-known football academies and federations.
whatIsCoerver.description2: Arsenal, Bayern Munich, Benfica, Dinamo Zagreb, the French Football Federation, the Japan Football Association – just some of the organisations using our methodology.

3.content: My daughter loves Coerver training! She comes back happy every time, excited to show off new tricks. The coaches' professionalism exceeds all expectations.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions

0.question: What ages are Coerver programs designed for?
0.answer: Our programs are tailored to all ages, both adults and younger players. Each age group has a specially designed program suited to their stage of development.

1.question: How long do training sessions last?
1.answer: Training sessions last 60-90 minutes, depending on the age group and type of program. Younger participants have shorter sessions adapted to their attention span.

2.question: How can I sign up?
2.answer: You can sign up via the contact form on this page, by email, or by phone. After signing up, we'll get back to you with details on available time slots.

3.question: Do I need to bring my own equipment?
3.answer: Depending on the program, coaches will let you know whether you need to bring your own equipment or whether we provide it.

hero.description: Your privacy matters to us. Here you can find out how we collect, use and protect your personal data.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.intro: The controller of your personal data is Coerver Coaching Croatia, headquartered in Zagreb, Croatia. For any questions related to the protection of personal data, you can contact us at:

dataCollected.title: 2. What Data We Collect
dataCollected.intro: We collect the following types of personal data:

items.0: Contact details: full name, email address, phone number
items.1: Child data: child's age/year of birth, jersey size, football club, position (for camp and academy registrations)
items.2: User account data: email address, password (encrypted), user role
items.3: Technical data: IP address, browser type, session cookies

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
purpose.intro: We use your personal data to:

items.0: Process registrations for camps, academies and courses
items.1: Communicate about our programs and services
items.3: Send notifications about news and offers (with your consent)

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.intro: We process your data based on:

items.0: Consent: when you give us explicit consent to process your data
items.1: Contractual obligation: when processing is necessary to perform a contract (e.g. a camp registration)
items.2: Legitimate interest: to improve our services and system security
items.3: Legal obligation: when we are legally required to retain certain data

sharing.title: 5. Sharing Data with Third Parties
sharing.intro: We may share your data with:

items.0: Supabase Inc. - database and authentication service provider (USA, subject to standard contractual clauses)
items.1: Vercel Inc. - hosting service provider (USA, subject to standard contractual clauses)

sharing.outro: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
cookies.intro: Our website uses the following types of cookies:

items.0: Essential cookies: required for the site to function and for user authentication
items.1: Session cookies: keep you logged in during your visit

cookies.outro: We currently do not use analytics or marketing cookies. You can manage cookie settings through your browser's settings.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:

items.0: Right of access: you can request a copy of all data we hold about you
items.1: Right to rectification: you can request correction of inaccurate data
items.2: Right to erasure: you can request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
items.3: Right to restriction of processing: you can request that we limit how we use your data
items.4: Right to data portability: you can request that your data be transferred to another controller
items.5: Right to object: you can object to processing based on legitimate interest
items.6: Right to withdraw consent: you can withdraw your consent at any time

rights.outro: To exercise any of the rights listed above, contact us at

retention.title: 8. Data Retention Period
retention.intro: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected:

items.0: Inquiry data: 2 years from receipt of the inquiry
items.1: Program registration data: 5 years from completion of the program
items.2: User accounts: until account closure + 30 days
items.3: Accounting data: in accordance with legal regulations (11 years)

security.title: 9. Data Security
security.intro: We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, loss or destruction. This includes:

items.3: Restricted access to data limited to authorized personnel

children.title: 10. Children's Data
children.text: Since our programs involve children, we pay special attention to protecting their data. We collect children's data solely with the consent of a parent or guardian, and only the data necessary for participation in our programs.

complaint.title: 11. Right to Lodge a Complaint
complaint.intro: If you believe that the processing of your personal data violates the GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority - the Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency (AZOP):

changes.title: 12. Changes to the Privacy Policy
changes.text: We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy. We will notify you of any significant changes via our website or by email. We recommend reviewing this page periodically.

questions.title: Have questions?
questions.text: For any questions related to the protection of your personal data, feel free to contact us:
